title: Unable to start crash reporter as app is restarting too frequently
symptom: After installing xDrip on a Samsung S21 to read from MiaoMiao/Libre, xDrip receives readings but closes as soon as the user taps Settings or History. Installing an older xDrip version (2021.01.02) made it worse, with xDrip crashing immediately on launch.
evidence_quote: I followed the normal steps to set up xdrip, installed it, then it requested 2 callobration test results which I did provide and i started getting readings. When I tried to access settings to set up follower phones and set other functions, xDrip kept crashing the moment i press in settings.
